title: (tests) centralized authz helper + lichen_coap_is_local_admin handler-level matrix
description: Tests bead for the enforcement bead (worker6-l9hb). lichen/tests/coap_lci_auth/src/main.c (201 lines) today covers ONLY address classification of lichen_coap_is_local_admin (coap_keys.c:51-98): loopback, SLIP scope_id match/mismatch, SLIP unavailable, global/short/non-IPv6 rejection. It has NO handler-level gate tests and NO test of the shared authorize helper once worker6-l9hb lands. ACCEPTANCE: extend lichen/tests/coap_lci_auth (or a sibling dir if cleaner) with: (1) helper-level matrix: {protected, unprotected} x {admin, non-admin} x {CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE on, off} -> expect 2.05 vs 4.01 vs fail-open-to-admin semantics per the Kconfig doc; (2) regression: every mutating handler migrated to the helper answers 4.01 for the unprotected non-admin probe (list the handlers from worker6-l9hb acceptance (1) and loop them); (3) is_protected request with unknown peer EUI64 -> 4.01 (ctx lookup fail path, coap_oscore.c:63-66); (4) keep existing classification tests green. Reuse the coap_packet fixture style of lichen/tests/coap_msg_inbox/src/main.c:30.
